source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#12
statement_en: If the sequence $x_n$ is nonnegative, then $$\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2.$$ Likewise for the limit inferior, $$\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2.$$
key_techniques: use transformation rule for limsup and liminf
callout_body: 如果序列$x_n$非负，那么$$\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\limsup_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2$$对于下极限也有$$\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n^2=\left(\liminf_{n\to \infty}x_n\right)^2$$
